input.text: Fictional Dubai health applications, eClaimLink-style structured claims, itemized bills, codes, plan rules, member history and provider statistics

work.text: Five JSON-schema-tool agents: enrollment, claim intake, coding review, coverage adjudication, fraud review; multi-step loops

output.text: Recorded eligibility, bill mismatches, coding findings, per-line pay/deny and denial codes, 0–1 fraud signals and pay/review/hold

criteria.text: Best quality and reliable tool calling over cost; existing Langfuse agent, call and end-to-end evals; human approves every claim

constraints.text: UAE health-data residency: endpoints must process in UAE; fictional test data permits non-UAE endpoints only as recorded residency gap; Cloudflare Workers AI and OpenRouter in use

assumptions: One distinct model choice per agent, reused in its tool-call rounds.
No provider restriction implied by existing integrations; endpoint residency must be verified independently, unknown counted outside UAE.
Token workloads are planning estimates pending trace measurements.

tasks.title: Enrollment
tasks.work: Extract declared chronic conditions as ICD-10-CM category prefixes and record eligibility using JSON-schema tools.
tasks.input: Application and free-text declaration; tool responses
tasks.output: Condition prefixes and recorded eligibility decision
tasks.summary: Start with Claude Opus 5 for condition prefixes; confirm eligibility and recording reliability on the two fixtures before deployment.

models.name: Claude Opus 5
models.rationale: Leads medical-code and revenue-cycle proxies and has multi-step tool-use evidence.
models.watchOut: ICD category extraction and eligibility are not directly measured.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.rationale: Best enterprise tool-use and healthcare workflow proxy.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.rationale: Strong revenue-cycle performance with tool support.

models.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
models.rationale: Useful alternative on complex agent workflows.
models.watchOut: No directly relevant coding score in cited results.

checks.metric: Chronic-condition category-prefix precision/recall and tool recording
checks.how: Score both existing enrollment fixtures and inspect call traces for rejected tools and missing recorded results.
Compare whole-run decisions to fixture labels and inspect tool retries.
Use already recorded human corrections where available rather than creating another eval.

evaluation.stopEarly: Stop a candidate after an unrecoverable schema failure or incorrect recorded decision on either fixture; two fixtures cannot establish statistical superiority.

tasks.title: Claims intake
tasks.work: Match bill lines to structured claim activities, calculate totals, identify mismatches and record result.
tasks.input: Structured eClaimLink-style claim, itemized bill, tool responses
tasks.output: Activity matches, totals and recorded mismatches
tasks.summary: Start with Claude Opus 5.5 for multi-step reconciliation; compare whole-claim mismatch and payment effects in existing Langfuse experiments.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.rationale: Strong tool-use and payer workflow proxies.

checks.metric: Bill-line match, totals, mismatch recall, schema failures
checks.how: Add candidate runs to the existing 14-claim Langfuse experiment and compare line labels and rejected-tool traces.
Compare recorded result to existing agent-run mismatch labels.
Compare existing end-to-end claim and payment labels and review-load scores.

evaluation.stopEarly: Stop after a clear excess of consequential missed mismatches or repeated rejected tool calls against the incumbent.

tasks.title: Medical coding review
tasks.work: Check ICD-10-CM and CPT using lookup tools; detect mismatch, unbundling and E/M upcoding and record findings.
tasks.input: Claim codes and lookup tool responses
tasks.summary: Start with Claude Opus 5 for coding findings; use lookup-tool outputs as authority, not model memory.

models.name: Claude Opus 5
models.rationale: Top MedCode and revenue-cycle benchmark standings with tool evidence.
models.watchOut: MedCode does not specifically assess CPT bundling or E/M upcoding.

models.name: Gemini 4 Argon
models.rationale: High coding and enterprise agent standing.

checks.metric: Finding precision/recall by mismatch, unbundling and E/M upcoding; valid lookup arguments
checks.how: Score candidates on existing coding-finding labels and rejected tool calls in the 14-claim Langfuse dataset.
Compare each coding-agent run to existing finding labels and lookup traces.

checks.metric: Incorrect payment and review load attributable to coding
checks.how: Use existing claim-level payment and review-load scores to compare candidate runs.

evaluation.stopEarly: Stop after a clearly consequential missed coding error or repeated fabricated lookup results relative to alternatives.

tasks.title: Coverage adjudication
tasks.work: Apply retrieved plan rules, decide pay or deny per line with denial codes, and record decisions; tool computes amounts.
tasks.input: Claim lines and plan-rule tool responses
tasks.output: Recorded per-line decisions and denial codes
tasks.summary: Start with Claude Opus 5.5 for rule-grounded line decisions; amounts remain tool-computed and every claim stays human-approved.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.rationale: Leads enterprise tool use and payer-adjacent healthcare workflow.

evidence.name: Public Benefits Bench v1.1 · Vals AI
Public Benefits Bench v1.1 · Vals AI

checks.metric: Per-line pay/deny and denial-code correctness; tool-schema rejection
checks.how: Run candidates in existing Langfuse experiments against the 14 claims' line-decision labels and tool traces.
Compare recorded decisions with existing adjudication agent-run labels.
Compare end-to-end payment labels and review-load scores after each candidate swap.

evaluation.stopEarly: Stop when a candidate makes repeated consequential wrong-pay decisions or fails to record line decisions despite retries.

tasks.title: Fraud review
tasks.work: Compare claim with member history and provider statistics; score signals and recommend pay/review/hold.
tasks.input: Claim, history and provider-statistics tool responses
tasks.summary: Start with Claude Opus 5.5 for evidence-grounded fraud recommendations; calibrate signal scores and avoid unnecessary holds using reviewer labels.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.rationale: Strong multi-step tools and healthcare workflow proxy.

models.name: Gemini 4 Argon
models.rationale: Strong tool workflows and data analysis.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.rationale: Strong healthcare and enterprise workflow alternative.

checks.metric: 0–1 signal validity, evidentiary support and successful tool recording
checks.how: Compare the existing 14 claims' fraud recommendations and tool-call traces, auditing signals against retrieved history and statistics.
Compare agent recommendations to existing labelled recommendations and reviewer decisions.

checks.metric: Correct claims, missed suspicious claims and review load
checks.how: Use the existing end-to-end claim-correct and review-load scores in Langfuse.

evaluation.stopEarly: Stop if unjustified holds or missed labelled review cases consistently exceed the strongest candidate.
